description: An exclusive gateway right after a task is the task's routing: its flows leave the task, FEEL and tool conditions become AWA conditions, and its default is the task's default edge.
bpmn:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:awa="https://awa.io/schema/interchange/1.1" id="Definitions_xor" targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn">
<bpmn:process id="P" name="Order routing">
<bpmn:startEvent id="S"/>
<bpmn:serviceTask id="T_check" name="Check order"/>
<bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G" name="Value?" default="F_std"/>
<bpmn:userTask id="T_approve" name="Approve"/>
<bpmn:serviceTask id="T_vip" name="VIP handling"/>
<bpmn:serviceTask id="T_std" name="Standard"/>
<bpmn:endEvent id="E"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="S" targetRef="T_check"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="T_check" targetRef="G"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_big" sourceRef="G" targetRef="T_approve" name="big"><bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" language="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/FEEL/">amount > 1000 and not(flagged)</bpmn:conditionExpression></bpmn:sequenceFlow>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_vip" sourceRef="G" targetRef="T_vip"><bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${tier == 'gold'}</bpmn:conditionExpression></bpmn:sequenceFlow>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_std" sourceRef="G" targetRef="T_std"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_a" sourceRef="T_approve" targetRef="E"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_v" sourceRef="T_vip" targetRef="E"/>
<bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_s" sourceRef="T_std" targetRef="E"/>
</bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
